title: Skills
subtitle: What the bots know how to do. A skill only enters the context when a bot needs it.

yours.title: Your skills
yours.hint: Imported, created by you or by the bots

taught.title: Taught
taught.hint: Procedures you showed on a bot's screen

builtin.title: Included in Milibot
builtin.hint: They come with the app and update with it. Per bot: in each bot's settings.

deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Its folder is removed and the bots stop using it.
folderNote: Each skill is a folder with a SKILL.md (and, if you want, scripts and templates). Copy folders into {{path}} and they show up here by themselves. In the VM the skill files are in {{vmPath}}, readable by every bot.

errors.noDescription: The SKILL.md has no “description”: bots only see the skill once it says what it is for.
errors.noFrontmatter: The SKILL.md must start with a block between --- lines with name and description.
errors.nameMismatch: The name in SKILL.md must match the folder name.
errors.builtinName: A skill included in Milibot already has this name. Rename the folder and the name in SKILL.md.
errors.folderName: The folder name may only have lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

codes.too_many_files: The skill has more than {{max}} files.
codes.too_large: The skill is larger than {{mb}} MB.
codes.no_frontmatter: SKILL.md must start with a block between --- lines with name and description.
codes.invalid_yaml: The SKILL.md header is not valid YAML ({{detail}}).
codes.frontmatter_not_fields: The SKILL.md header must have “key: value” fields.
codes.name_too_long: The name has more than {{max}} characters.
codes.name_invalid: The name may only have lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
codes.description_missing: SKILL.md has no “description”: bots only see a skill that says what it is for.
codes.description_too_long: The description is longer than {{max}} characters.
codes.invalid_extension: The “milibot” block of SKILL.md is not valid.
codes.not_in_scan: Not part of this search. Search again.

newDialog.title: New skill
newDialog.description: Write what the bot should know how to do. It becomes a folder with a SKILL.md you can add to later.
newDialog.name: Name
newDialog.nameTaken: A skill with this name already exists.
newDialog.whenToUsePlaceholder: E.g.: Check the bank statement against the spreadsheet. Load it before reconciling a month.

import.title: Import skills
import.subtitle: From a folder, a SKILL.md, a .zip or a GitHub repository.
import.drop: Drop a folder, a SKILL.md or a .zip here
import.hint: Takes a repository (owner/name), one of its folders (/tree/…) or the link to a SKILL.md.

conflicts.nameTaken: Name in use · comes in as {{name}}

import.scriptsNote: Skills with scripts run code in the virtual machine when a bot uses them. Only import from sources you trust.

errors.notFoundNoToken: Repository not found. If it is private, add a GitHub token.
errors.github_ref_not_found: That branch, tag or commit is not in the repository.
errors.github_unauthorized: GitHub refused the configured token. Replace it in GitHub and credentials.
errors.github_rate_limited: GitHub is limiting requests right now. Try again in a few minutes (a token raises the limit).
errors.github_unreachable: Could not reach GitHub. Check the internet connection.
errors.github_failed: GitHub did not answer as expected. Try again.
errors.invalid_url: That address was not recognized. Use owner/repository or a GitHub link.
errors.too_large: The repository is too large to import from here (over 50 MB). Point to the skill's folder.
errors.too_many_files: Too many files in that folder. Choose the skill's folder.
errors.path_not_found: That file or folder was not found.
errors.unsupported_file: Drop a folder, a SKILL.md, a .zip or a .skill.
errors.not_a_zip: That file is not a valid .zip.
errors.source_missing: This skill's source is no longer available.

detail.readOnly: Included in Milibot: duplicate it to edit.
detail.builtinNote: Included in Milibot and updated with the app. Duplicate it to change it.
detail.taughtNote: The steps of this taught skill are edited in the bot's settings, under “Taught steps”.
detail.disabledFor: Turned off for {{names}} in the bot settings.
detail.onlyFor: On only for {{names}}. For other bots, turn it on in each one's settings.
detail.onlyForNone: No bot has it on. Turn it on in a bot's settings.

origin.title: Source
origin.user: Created in the app or copied into the folder on {{date}}

detail.usageText_one: Loaded {{count}} time in the last {{days}} days by {{names}}.
detail.usageText_other: Loaded {{count}} times in the last {{days}} days by {{names}}.
detail.usageNone: No bot loaded this skill in the last {{days}} days.
detail.noVm: SKILL.md only: nothing is copied to the VM.

web-browsing.name: Web browsing
web-browsing.description: Read pages as text, fill in forms and handle dialogs and errors in the bot's Chrome.

using-the-screen.name: Using the screen
using-the-screen.description: Desktop apps through the bot's screen, in batches of actions and with few screenshots. Includes what you taught.

code-and-repos.name: Code and repositories
code-and-repos.description: A worktree per bot, Docker isolated per project and pull requests that show up as chat cards.

team-management.name: Team management
team-management.description: Create, adjust and remove bots and groups, and write a good prompt for each specialist.

projects.name: Projects
projects.description: Lasting lines of work, with their own notes and documents.

plans-and-sessions.name: Plans
plans-and-sessions.description: Plans for approval, step-by-step execution and long work sessions.

boards.name: Boards
boards.description: Kanban boards for large goals: the bot splits them into cards and plans each one on its own.

knowledge-base.name: Knowledge
knowledge-base.description: Look up and cite the workspace's documents and keep reference material.

routines.name: Routines
routines.description: Tasks that run by themselves on a schedule: daily, weekly, reminders.

secrets-and-variables.name: Passwords and variables
secrets-and-variables.description: Ask for passwords and keys safely and use them by reference, never shown in the chat.

skill-creator.name: Creating skills
skill-creator.description: Write and save new skills from what the bot learned to do.

design.name: Design
design.description: Draw screens, presentations and documents on the Canvas, with variables, themes and layout checks.

slides.name: Presentations
slides.description: 16:9 slides on the Canvas, exported to PDF or PowerPoint by a script in the skill.

documents-pdf.name: PDF documents
documents-pdf.description: A4 pages on the Canvas, exported to PDF.

design-to-code.name: Design to code
design-to-code.description: Turn Canvas screens into code with the same tokens.
